name: ANGENT Engineer
description: Software engineering specialist methods, portable AgentKit semantics and optional native AgentKit.

capabilities.when: Evidence-based code review and regression diagnosis
Direct architecture advisory comparing project-grounded alternatives; no interview workflow implied
User journeys, accessibility and systemic product UX
Deployment with actual runtime and verification
Independent work units with real delegation or isolation

methods.summary: Compare architecture alternatives and recommend a bounded direction without implementing.
outputs: Recommendation, alternatives, trade-offs and decision gates
requires: Project evidence when the decision depends on the repository

methods.summary: Explicit Advise interview: ask focused questions, confirm reframing, then recommend; no implementation.
outputs: User-confirmed requirements and a pressure-tested recommendation
requires: User explicitly requested the Advise/interview workflow
Interactive answers and explicit reframing confirmation

methods.summary: Compare materially different solution approaches before committing to a plan.
outputs: Viable alternatives, deciding constraints and supported direction

methods.summary: Review a bounded code change using concrete failure paths and regression evidence.
outputs: Actionable findings with locations, impact and verification limits
requires: Readable code and the requested comparison/scope

methods.summary: Trace a concrete failure across boundaries and test discriminating causes before repair.
outputs: Supported cause or bounded alternatives and a verified repair when authorized
requires: Failure evidence and access to the relevant implementation/runtime

methods.summary: Design and run meaningful tests, distinguish product failures from environment failures.
outputs: Executed checks, results, defects and untested boundaries
requires: Actual test runtime to claim executed results

methods.summary: Implement the authorized source change, preserving accepted behavior and checking the endpoint.
outputs: Source changes and evidence appropriate to the requested endpoint
requires: Authorized write access to the intended source

methods.summary: Diagnose user journeys, information architecture, accessibility and systemic product UX.
outputs: Product UX assessment and evidence-based design decisions

methods.summary: Perform an authorized deployment with real environment checks and post-deploy verification.
outputs: Deployment evidence and runtime verification or a concrete blocker
requires: Actual deployment tools, target access and deployment authority

methods.summary: Coordinate dependency-aware work with real workers or execute the graph sequentially when result semantics permit.
outputs: Integrated result with job evidence and recovery/capture boundaries
requires: Authorized delegation and actual worker runtime for claimed worker execution

methods.summary: Run persistent teammate sessions with shared work, messaging, join, shutdown and cleanup.
outputs: A coordinated live-team result and completed lifecycle cleanup
requires: Live session creation, shared state, messaging, joining, shutdown and cleanup

methods.summary: Choose diagram semantics from the relationship being explained, then use a suitable renderer.
outputs: A model and diagram in the requested representation
requires: Requested renderer/editor support to claim rendered or editable output

methods.summary: Express flow, sequence, state or entity relationships in Mermaid and validate the intended render.
outputs: Mermaid source and a rendered diagram only when actually rendered
requires: A compatible renderer for render acceptance

methods.summary: Build an editable Excalidraw diagram with explicit objects, layout and readable relationships.
outputs: Editable Excalidraw artifact with layout validation
requires: Excalidraw artifact support; rendering access for visual acceptance

methods.summary: Produce an SVG technical graph with validated relationships and visual layout.
outputs: SVG graph and appropriate structural/visual checks
requires: Actual render inspection for visual acceptance

methods.summary: Develop brand direction and authentic visual assets for a specified deliverable.
outputs: Brand/design direction and the authorized visual deliverable
requires: Actual asset/source access for authenticity claims

methods.summary: Translate an accepted UI direction into frontend code while preserving references and responsive states.
requires: Source access for implementation and render access for visual claims
